rendererConfigurationEvidence.outputColorSpace: SRGBColorSpace inferred from the R3F default branch when gl.outputColorSpace is unspecified; Canvas does not override it
rendererConfigurationEvidence.toneMapping: ACESFilmicToneMapping inferred from the R3F default branch because WorkspaceCanvas flat defaults false and Canvas has no toneMapping override

colorAndAlpha.workingValues: Stored PNG RGB byte values compared directly, without resizing, crop, or color conversion. The original and screenshot contain no standard sRGB/gAMA/iCCP/cHRM profile chunk; the reference has a private caBX ancillary chunk. Thus these are encoded-byte comparisons, not proof of a shared source color profile. Both full-frame PNGs are fully opaque, so screenshot-level alpha compositing is not causing transparent-pixel mismatches. The 50% overlay is an arithmetic mean in encoded RGB byte space.
